title: Aliped
summary: AL'IPED, adjective [Latin ala, wing, and pes, foot.] Wing-footed; having the toes connected by a membrane, which serves as a wing. AL'IPED, noun [Supra.] An animal whose toes are connected by a membra

inlines.v: AL'IPED, adjective [Latin ala, wing, and pes, foot.] Wing-footed; having the toes connected by a membrane, which serves as a wing. AL'IPED, noun [Supra.] An animal whose toes are connected by a membrane, and which thus serve for wings; a cheiropter; as, the bat.
